description: Agent Access: submit a settlement claim (transaction reference, amount, asset, destination, network, what the claim rests on, whether delivery was made against it), the chain evidence read for it, each reading with its source, whether that source stands outside the seller and its facilitator, whether it found the transaction, its status (success, reverted, pending or dropped), the amount, asset, destination, network, confirmations, finality and when it was read, and the confirmations the receiver requires. The signed report says whether the transaction exists, is final and matches the claim field by field, and names every claim whose only proof is the seller’s own receipt, record or facilitator response, every settlement that reverted or was dropped after an earlier success, and every delivery made before finality. Two records agreeing with each other are wever_settlement-reconciliation-check, an invoice against a payment record is wever_invoice-payment-match and proof of a code change is wever_change-proof-check. Verdict settlement_failed, self_attested, settlement_unverified or settlement_proven. POST /api/settlement-proof-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-access-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-access/.

asset.description: Such as USDC or a token contract address.

delivered.description: Goods or access were delivered against it.

evidence.description: Chain evidence read for the claim, in the order it was read.

finalized.description: The block is final under the network rule.

independent.description: The source is outside the seller and its facilitator.

observed.description: When it was read, as a date.

source.description: Where the evidence was read, such as a block explorer or an RPC node.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

name: wever_settlement-proof-check
title: Settlement proof check
